instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Accounts of her exploits were greatly exaggerated.
atoms.b: Accounts of her exploits were greatly ((exaggerated)).

atoms.a: You can have an adventure just by reading a book.
atoms.b: You can have an ((adventure)) just by reading a book.

atoms.a: Who do you think would have the advantage in a race: a dolphin or a squid?
atoms.b: Who do you think would have the ((advantage)) in a race: a dolphin or a squid?

atoms.a: I have an admission to make. I drank the rest of the juice.
atoms.b: I have an ((admission)) to make. I drank the rest of the juice.

atoms.a: I don’t want to ask for approval before going to the park, but I have to.
atoms.b: I don’t want to ask for ((approval)) before going to the park, but I have to.

atoms.a: If I could just persuade my mum she also likes tacos, we could eat them for dinner more often.
atoms.b: If I could just ((persuade)) my mum she also likes tacos, we could eat them for dinner more often.

atoms.a: I heard a rumour that Jane would run for class clown again this year.
atoms.b: I heard a ((rumour)) that Jane would run for class clown again this year.

atoms.a: I am afraid that the wizard will appear in my dream again tonight.
atoms.b: I am afraid that the wizard will ((appear)) in my dream again tonight.

parentBlock.title: Spelling Practice (1) - exaggerate, adventure, advantage, admission, approval, persuade, rumour, appear
